description: Live radar stories with 3+ outlets that gained no new outlet for 6 hours while their headline is still a statement, promise, threat or demand (Searle word rules). Saturation is not confirmation (Daley-Kendall, 'Epidemics and Rumours', 1964). Verdicts collecting, few/some/many_saturated_unsettled, with examples. Uses per-outlet publication times recorded since 25.11.2026. Rule-based, no AI. In honour of David G. Kendall (1918-2007).
name: get_kendall_rumour
title: Kendall sensor: which radar stories stopped spreading without being confirmed
